findings.evidence: SQLiteSupportToolGateway catches only sqlite3.Error, then unconditionally destructures the provider result before validation. Wrong tuple shape or an unexpected provider exception escapes; tests cover malformed scalar fields but not malformed tuple shape or provider exceptions.
findings.problem: The provider boundary is not closed for malformed or unexpected responses.
findings.harm: A malformed external response can produce an unhandled server error instead of the required safe contract-invalid response.
findings.fix: Validate result shape before unpacking and normalize malformed shapes and unexpected provider failures into closed typed outcomes; add wrong-arity, non-iterable and unexpected-exception tests.

findings.evidence: The FastAPI router lives inside knora.tools and imports authenticate_principal from knora.adapters.http.routes, while the documented seam keeps HTTP adapters under knora.adapters.http and application modules independent of adapters.
findings.problem: The tool application package owns an HTTP adapter and reverses the documented dependency direction.
findings.harm: The tool application boundary is coupled to FastAPI and the existing HTTP adapter.
findings.fix: Move the tool router/schema under knora.adapters.http while keeping knora.tools application-only.

findings.evidence: Locked TC-01 requires LookupTicketRequest to carry exact authorized binding identity/version/digest. AuthorizedExternalResource and LookupTicketRequest drop those fields, ReadTool constructs only scope/resource, and the cited test never asserts binding provenance while the approved Evaluation claims it.
findings.problem: The read gateway boundary cannot preserve exact approved binding provenance.
findings.harm: Release evidence cannot prove exact Workspace-to-external-scope binding semantics and an adapter may receive a scope without the approved binding identity/version/digest.
findings.fix: Carry exact binding identity/version/digest through the typed authorized resource/request seam and assert them in fake/SQLite request evidence before rerunning acceptance.

standards.report: Prior v1 authorization/runtime/digest findings are addressed; malformed provider response closure remains Major and HTTP adapter placement is Minor.

spec.report: Prior v1 items are addressed; exact binding provenance is missing from the typed lookup boundary and TC-01 evidence.
